description: This is a Python script implementing a command-line utility for building, installing, and running Android tests, including options parsing, test discovery, build orchestration, and device interaction.

classes.name: TestRunner
classes.description: A class providing command-line test execution, build, and device management functionalities.

methods.name: _ProcessOptions
methods.description: Parses and processes command-line options for test execution.

methods.name: _ReadTests
methods.description: Reads and parses test definitions from XML files.

methods.name: _DumpTests
methods.description: Prints the list of available tests.

methods.name: _DoBuild
methods.description: Coordinates the build process for tests.

methods.name: _DoPermissionAwareBuild
methods.description: Builds tests with or without permission requirements.

methods.name: _DoFullBuild
methods.description: Performs a full make build for tests requiring it.

methods.name: _AddBuildTarget
methods.description: Adds build targets for a test suite.

methods.name: _AddBuildTargetPath
methods.description: Adds a specific build path to the build target tree.

methods.name: _GetTestsToRun
methods.description: Determines which tests to run based on command-line options.

methods.name: _TurnOffVerifier
methods.description: Disables the Dalvik verifier if required by tests.

methods.name: _ChmodRuntimeReset
methods.description: Resets permissions and runtime environment on device.

methods.name: RunTests
methods.description: Main method to execute the test process based on options.
